mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_NO, N.TITLE, N.NOTICE_TYPE, N.ADMIN_NO, A.ADMIN_NAME, N.CREATED_DATE, N.UPDATED_DATE FROM NOTICE N JOIN ADMIN A ON N.ADMIN_NO = A.ADMIN_NO ORDER BY CASE WHEN N.NOTICE_TYPE = '공지' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, N.NOTICE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT N.NOTICE_NO, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.NOTICE_TYPE, N.ADMIN_NO, A.ADMIN_NAME, N.CREATED_DATE, N.UPDATED_DATE FROM NOTICE N JOIN ADMIN A ON N.ADMIN_NO = A.ADMIN_NO WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO NOTICE (NOTICE_NO, TITLE, CONTENT, NOTICE_TYPE, ADMIN_NO, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{noticeNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{adminNo}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
